def solve(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    # find frame color = most common in left region... split: left region = columns up to first all-zero separator column
    # find zero column
    zc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(inp[r][c]==0 for r in range(h)))
    left=[row[:zc] for row in inp]; right=[row[zc+1:] for row in inp]
    fc=inp[0][0]
    hw=len(left[0])
    # frames: rows where left row is all fc
    frame_rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==fc for x in left[r])]
    # frame row groups
    groups=[]; cur=[frame_rows[0]]
    for r in frame_rows[1:]:
        if r==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: groups.append(cur); cur=[r]
    groups.append(cur)
    # shapes on right
    cols=range(len(right[0]))
    shape_cols=[c for c in cols if any(right[r][c]!=0 for r in range(h))]
    shapes=[]
    used=set()
    for c in shape_cols:
        if c in used: continue
        # color
        col=next(right[r][c] for r in range(h) if right[r][c]!=0)
        cells=[(r,cc) for r in range(h) for cc in range(len(right[0])) if right[r][cc]==col]
        for _,cc in cells: used.add(cc)
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[cc for _,cc in cells]
        sub=[[1 if (r,cc) in set(cells) else 0 for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
        shapes.append((sum(map(sum,sub)), col, sub))
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:-s[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in left]
    for (n,col,sub),g in zip(shapes,groups):
        r0,r1=g[0],g[-1]
        rh=r1-r0-1
        # inner region rows r0+1..r1-1, cols 1..hw-2
        ih=rh; iw=hw-2
        sh=len(sub); sw=len(sub[0])
        off_r=(ih-sh)//2; off_c=(iw-sw)//2
        for i,srow in enumerate(sub):
            for j,v in enumerate(srow):
                if v: out[r0+1+off_r+i][1+off_c+j]=col
    return out
